publications.title: Electrospun nanofiber membranes as transdermal delivery vehicles for vitamin C derivatives
publications.authors: Nováková J., Kolář M., Šimánek V.
publications.abstract: This study investigates the use of electrospun PVA/PVP composite membranes as transdermal delivery systems for ascorbic acid derivatives, demonstrating superior skin penetration compared to conventional emulsion formulations.

publications.title: Biocompatibility assessment of polymer nanofiber scaffolds for cosmetic applications
publications.abstract: A systematic biocompatibility evaluation of electrospun scaffolds from five cosmetic-grade polymers using standardised ISO 10993 protocols.

publications.title: Retinol stabilisation in electrospun nanofiber matrices: a comparative study
publications.authors: Nováková J., Ruml T., Kolář M.
publications.abstract: Comparison of retinol stability in PVP, PVA, and zein nanofiber matrices under accelerated aging conditions.

publications.title: Electrospinning of Natural Polymers for Cosmetic Delivery Systems
publications.abstract: Invited conference talk presenting results on natural polymer nanofiber fabrication for cosmetic active delivery.
